rationale: C12 is the strongest plausible template because it is an earlier executive order with the same highly specific function and nearly identical title formula: exempting a named individual from compulsory retirement for age. C08 and C15 are similarly strong precedents, but C12 is the most recent. Although the operative texts were not published, the matching individualized legal mechanism is concrete and material rather than merely topical.
